landmarks.name: Individual landmarks (LPC)
landmarks.processing: Lot centroid; Gaussian distance decay σ 100 m (cutoff 300 m) along the street

street_trees.name: Street & park trees (live)
street_trees.dataset: NYC Parks Forestry Tree Points (structure = Full)
street_trees.source: NYC Parks via NYC Open Data
street_trees.processing: Snapped to the nearest street segment within 30 m, counted per km

parks.name: Parks & green spaces
parks.source: NYC Parks via NYC Open Data
parks.processing: Share of points 0/±20/±40 m from the street inside a park property

cultural_venues.name: Museums & cultural venues
cultural_venues.dataset: OSM museums, galleries, theatres, arts centres, cinemas, libraries, music venues
cultural_venues.processing: Gaussian distance decay σ 150 m (cutoff 450 m)

public_art.name: Public art
public_art.processing: Part of the scenic-feature distance decay σ 100 m (cutoff 300 m); context only for Culture

scenic_points.name: Viewpoints, fountains & memorials
scenic_points.processing: Gaussian distance decay σ 100 m (cutoff 300 m)

noise_complaints.name: 311 noise complaints (12 months)
noise_complaints.dataset: NYC 311 Service Requests, complaint type Noise*
noise_complaints.processing: Gaussian distance decay σ 50 m (cutoff 150 m); fewer is quieter. Complaints are reports, not measured sound levels

sidewalk_surface.name: Sidewalk surface (planimetric)
sidewalk_surface.source: NYC OTI via NYC Open Data
sidewalk_surface.processing: Share of points 5–14 m either side of the street inside sidewalk polygons (sidewalk-width proxy)

seating.name: Benches & seating
seating.processing: Shown for orientation; not part of any score

activity_places.name: Activity places (all categories)
activity_places.dataset: OSM amenity, shop, tourism, leisure, historic features
activity_places.processing: Category diversity × ln(1 + places) within 150 m of the segment midpoint

food_drink.name: Restaurants, cafés & bars
food_drink.processing: Gaussian distance decay σ 50 m (cutoff 150 m)

retail.name: Shops
retail.processing: Gaussian distance decay σ 50 m (cutoff 150 m), together with food & drink

intersections.name: Street intersections (3+ way)
intersections.dataset: Derived from NYC Street Centerline (LION) nodes
intersections.processing: LION nodes joining 3+ walkable segments, counted within 250 m

osm_sidewalks.name: Sidewalks (routing network)
osm_sidewalks.dataset: OSM footway=sidewalk edges of the pedestrian graph
osm_sidewalks.processing: Edges of the routing graph osm-walk-20261023-99602011; carry LION-matched scores but are not an indicator

osm_crosswalks.name: Crosswalks (routing network)
osm_crosswalks.dataset: OSM footway=crossing edges of the pedestrian graph

osm_paths.name: Pedestrian paths & steps (routing network)
osm_paths.dataset: OSM footway/path/pedestrian/steps edges of the pedestrian graph

pedestrian_crashes.name: Pedestrian injury crashes (3 years)
pedestrian_crashes.dataset: NYPD Motor Vehicle Collisions – Crashes (pedestrians injured or killed)
pedestrian_crashes.processing: Gaussian distance decay σ 40 m (cutoff 120 m); fewer is safer. Not adjusted for pedestrian volume

expressways.name: Expressways & ramps
expressways.dataset: NYC Street Centerline (LION) road types Highway and Ramp
expressways.processing: Distance from the segment midpoint to the nearest expressway/ramp (capped 1,500 m); traffic-pollution exposure proxy

subway_entrances.name: Subway entrances
subway_entrances.processing: Entrances with entry allowed within 400 m, and distance to the nearest one

building_footprints.name: Building footprints
building_footprints.reason: NYC Building Footprints not connected yet.

historic_districts.name: Historic districts
historic_districts.reason: LPC Historic Districts not connected yet; Architecture uses individual landmarks only.

tree_canopy.name: Tree canopy
tree_canopy.reason: Canopy (LiDAR land cover raster) not connected; Nature uses tree points and park land.

traffic_noise.name: Modelled traffic noise
traffic_noise.reason: No measured or modelled sound-level layer; Quiet uses 311 complaints and roadway width.

traffic_volume.name: Traffic volume
traffic_volume.reason: NYC DOT traffic counts not connected.

shade.name: Shade
shade.reason: No shade model or canopy raster connected.

sidewalk_amenities.name: Sidewalk amenities (beyond seating)
sidewalk_amenities.reason: Street furniture inventory not connected; benches from OSM are shown under Seating.

land_use.name: Land use (MapPLUTO)
land_use.reason: MapPLUTO land use not connected; Vibrancy uses OSM place mix.

risk_areas.name: Risk areas
risk_areas.reason: No validated risk-area layer; Safety uses crash records only.

air_quality.name: Air quality (NYCCAS)
air_quality.reason: NYC Community Air Survey rasters not connected; Environment uses distance to expressways.

urban_heat.name: Urban heat
urban_heat.reason: Heat vulnerability / surface temperature not connected.

bus_stops.name: Bus stops
bus_stops.reason: MTA bus stops (GTFS) not connected; Transit uses subway entrances only.

distances: scoring_distance_m = spatial range used by the indicator; display_distance_m = default Along Route display range only (changing it never changes a score).

architecture.label: Landmark proximity
architecture.method: Gaussian distance decay Σexp(−d²/2σ²), σ 100 m, cutoff 300 m, mean of points every 40 m along the segment

architecture.label: Individual landmarks within 150 m
architecture.method: Landmark lot centroids within 150 m of the segment midpoint

nature.label: Living street trees per km
nature.method: Trees with structure "Full" within 30 m, snapped to the nearest segment, ÷ length (80 m floor)

nature.label: Beside parkland
nature.method: Share of points 0/±20/±40 m from the centreline inside NYC Parks properties

nature.label: Living trees along segment
nature.method: Raw count behind trees per km

culture.label: Cultural venue proximity
culture.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 150 m, cutoff 450 m: museums, galleries, theatres, arts centres, cinemas, libraries, music venues

culture.label: Cultural venues within 200 m
culture.method: Count within 200 m of the segment midpoint

quiet.label: 311 noise complaint intensity
quiet.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 50 m, cutoff 150 m, last 12 months; fewer is better. Reporting depends on who calls 311

quiet.label: Roadway width
quiet.method: LION street width; narrower carries less through-traffic noise. N/A where NYC does not record a width

quiet.label: Noise complaints along segment
quiet.method: Complaints within 40 m, snapped to the nearest segment

spatial_comfort.label: Sidewalk surface beside the street
spatial_comfort.method: Share of points 5/8/11/14 m either side of the centreline inside planimetric sidewalk polygons (a sidewalk-width proxy). N/A on park paths and step streets

urban_vibrancy.label: Activity mix index
urban_vibrancy.method: Normalised Shannon diversity of place categories × ln(1 + places), within 150 m

urban_vibrancy.label: Places within 150 m
urban_vibrancy.method: OSM amenity, shop, tourism, leisure and historic features

urban_vibrancy.label: Category diversity
urban_vibrancy.method: Normalised Shannon entropy of those places

food_retail.label: Food & shop proximity
food_retail.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 50 m, cutoff 150 m: restaurants, cafés, bars, fast food and all shops

food_retail.label: Food & shops per km
food_retail.method: Places within 60 m snapped to the nearest segment ÷ length (80 m floor)

food_retail.label: Food & shops along segment
food_retail.method: Raw count behind places per km

scenic_visual.label: Scenic feature proximity
scenic_visual.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 100 m, cutoff 300 m: viewpoints, public artworks, fountains, memorials, monuments

scenic_visual.label: Scenic features within 150 m
scenic_visual.method: Count within 150 m of the segment midpoint

walkability.label: Intersections within 250 m
walkability.method: Centreline nodes joining 3+ walkable segments (streets, paths, step streets, alleys) within 250 m of the midpoint

access_safety.label: Pedestrian injury crash intensity
access_safety.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 40 m, cutoff 120 m, crashes injuring or killing pedestrians, last 3 years; fewer is better. Not adjusted for pedestrian volume

access_safety.label: Pedestrian injury crashes within 25 m
access_safety.method: Count within 25 m of the segment, last 3 years

environment.label: Distance to expressway or ramp
environment.method: Midpoint to nearest expressway/ramp centreline, capped at 1,500 m; farther means less traffic-pollution exposure

transit_connectivity.label: Subway entrances within 400 m
transit_connectivity.method: Entrances with entry allowed within 400 m of the midpoint

transit_connectivity.label: Distance to nearest subway entrance
transit_connectivity.method: Midpoint to nearest entrance, capped at 1,500 m

source_labels.streets: NYC Street Centerline (LION), NYC DCP via ArcGIS
source_labels.trees: NYC Parks Forestry Tree Points (live inventory)

scoring_snapshot.note: Scores were computed from this snapshot; layers show the records retrieved on retrieved/updated dates and can differ by recent additions.
